privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: This notice is issued in compliance with Colombian Law 1581 of 2012 on personal data protection. We do not use tracking cookies or show a cookie banner.

privacy.retention: Records are kept for 30 days and then deleted. They are never shared with or sold to third parties. We honor the Global Privacy Control signal: if your browser sends it, your visit is not recorded.
